introduction: South Carolina LIHEAP applications go to the local Community Action agency. The Office of Economic Opportunity does not accept household applications.
description: South Carolina LIHEAP applications go to the local Community Action agency. The Office of Economic Opportunity does not accept household applications.

sections.who: Local intake assesses income, residence, status and current heating or cooling need. The energy bill must be in an adult household member’s name.
sections.get: Assistance helps with eligible home-energy costs, subject to funds and local limits.
sections.docs:
• Residence and requested status evidence.
  • Recent household income records.
  • Energy bill and any crisis notice.
sections.apply:
1. Find local intake

    Follow the Community Action link on the state LIHEAP page.

  2. Explain the need

    Ask about available funding and the local checklist.

  3. Submit records

    Keep confirmation and respond to further requests.
sections.after: Contact the utility while awaiting a decision and ask the agency about any disputed result.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Local eligibility and application. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Should I mail the application to OEO?
No. OEO explicitly directs household applications to local agencies.
No. The state describes heating and cooling energy assistance.
Will it cover the entire bill?
The state says assistance is limited and not intended to cover all energy costs.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
